title: Identifying speaker stance and purpose
source: Language Learning Hub · original V4.4 teaching draft, not an external textbook
goal: Apply identifying speaker stance and purpose in an original academic-English context and explain reasoning in coherent English
context: 从用词和让步判断讲者对开放式办公室的立场。
grammar: stance 不只来自 I think。worth considering、not necessarily、provided that 暗示有条件接受。先区分描述他人观点与讲者本人判断，避免把引用当成立场。
common_mistake: 讲者承认一个优势，不等于全面支持方案。

examples.text: Some managers describe open offices as a simple way to improve collaboration.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: Yet it is easy to overstate the benefit of constant visibility.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: Staff who analyse complex material may need long periods without interruption.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

reading: Some managers describe open offices as a simple way to improve collaboration. I can see why the idea appeals to them, particularly when teams need quick exchanges. Yet it is easy to overstate the benefit of constant visibility. Staff who analyse complex material may need long periods without interruption. A shared office is worth considering provided that quiet spaces are genuinely available. My purpose is not to defend one layout for every workplace. It is to ask which activities a design supports and which it makes harder.

questions.prompt: Is the speaker's attitude unconditional support ?
questions.answer: No, it is conditional acceptance with reservations.
questions.explanation: provided that 明确限制条件。

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the talk ?
questions.answer: To evaluate layouts against the activities they support.
questions.explanation: 结尾明确评价标准，而非推荐统一布局。
